captions.text: Can an oilfield engineer pull up the lease behind a well?
Battalion says it has signed up for Collide.
The plan starts with scattered well files and contracts.
Connect them in one searchable model.
Then an engineer could see the lease obligations shaping a drilling decision.
The company warns integration and staff adoption could fail.
Battalion sees a fit at Monument Draw in Ward County.
The proposed change is a joined record.
A better drilling decision still has to be proved.
